literal: In the second month, on the guihai day, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of Staff with Full Powers, Palace Attendant, General of Agile Cavalry, and Duke of Daifang Commandery; his kingship remained as before.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the guihai day, King Yuchang of Baekje was appointed bearer of staff with full powers, palace attendant, general of agile cavalry, and duke of Daifang Commandery, retaining his royal title.

literal: On the jisi day, Grand Tutor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang was appointed Right Chancellor; Inspector of Bing Province, Right Chancellor, and Prince Hebaren of Anding was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; and Inspector of Ji Province and Prince Jie of Rencheng was made Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On the jisi day, Grand Tutor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang was made right chancellor; Prince Hebaren of Anding, inspector of Bing Province and right chancellor, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; and Prince Jie of Rencheng, inspector of Ji Province, was appointed grand preceptor.

literal: On the bingzi day, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, sentences were reduced for all prisoners convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

literal: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing and Prince Hebaren of Anding died.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Prince Hebaren of Anding, recorder of the Masters of Writing, died.

literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Xu Zhicai, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Xu Zhicai, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, was made left deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: In the sixth month of summer, on the yiyou day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the yiyou day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was appointed minister of works.

literal: On the jiachen day, because of the death of the prince Heng, a general amnesty was proclaimed; all inner and outer officials were universally promoted two ranks, and functionaries of the nine provinces were universally promoted four ranks.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, mourning for the death of Prince Heng brought a general amnesty; every civil and military official was promoted two ranks, and every provincial functionary four.

literal: On the jiyou day, an edict appointed Tang Yong, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day, an edict made Tang Yong, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, the sons of Emperor Xiaozhao were enfeoffed: Yanji as Prince of Chengyang, Yankang as Prince of Dingling, and Yanzhong as Prince of Liang Commandery.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, Emperor Xiaozhao's sons were ennobled: Yanji as prince of Chengyang, Yankang as prince of Dingling, and Yanzhong as prince of Liang Commandery.

literal: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Changgong of Lanling was made recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander He Shikai was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Prince Changgong of Lanling, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander He Shikai was appointed chief minister.

literal: On the guihai day, the Mojie sent envoys to pay court tribute.
idiomatic: On the guihai day, envoys from Mojie arrived to pay court tribute.

literal: On the guiyou day, Prince Ning of Huashan was made Grand Tutor.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Prince Ning of Huashan was appointed grand tutor.

literal: In the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the prince Heng was established as crown prince.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, Prince Heng was formally established as crown prince.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Minister of Works Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister over the Masses; Prince Sizong of Shangluo was made Minister of Works; and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Prince Sizong of Shangluo was appointed minister of works; and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as prince of Liang.

literal: On the wuzi day, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below in Bing Province were partially reduced.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, sentences were partially reduced for all prisoners in Bing Province convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

literal: On the jichou day, the posthumous title of Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong was again changed to "Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan."
idiomatic: On the jichou day, the posthumous title of Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong was restored to "Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan."

literal: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: An edict ordered Right Chancellor Hulu Guang to go out by the Jinzhou route and repair fortifications and garrisons.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Right Chancellor Hulu Guang to take the Jinzhou route and repair the frontier walls and garrisons.

literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the dingsi day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Liu Huanjun as envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month of spring in the second year, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Liu Huanjun as envoy to Chen.

literal: On the wuyin day, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of Staff with Full Powers, Commissioner-in-Chief, and Governor of Eastern Qing Province.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, King Yuchang of Baekje was appointed bearer of staff with full powers, commissioner-in-chief, and governor of Eastern Qing Province.

literal: In the second month, on the renyin day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Commandant; Zhao Yanshen of the Bing Secretariat, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister of Works; Chief Minister of the Secretariat He Shikai was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Left Deputy Director Xu Zhicai was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Right Deputy Director Tang Yong was made Left Deputy Director; and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day, Prince Changgong of Lanling, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made grand commandant; Zhao Yanshen of the Bing Masters of Writing, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister of works; Chief Minister He Shikai was made recorder; Left Deputy Director Xu Zhicai was made chief minister; Right Deputy Director Tang Yong was made left deputy director; and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong was made right deputy director.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Yan of Langye was made Grand Guardian.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Yan of Langye was appointed grand guardian.

literal: On the jiawu day, Chen dispatched envoys proposing an alliance to plan an attack on Zhou; the court deliberation did not permit it.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, envoys from Chen arrived proposing an alliance for a joint campaign against Zhou, but the court refused.

literal: In the sixth month, Duan Shao attacked Fen Province of Zhou, captured it, and took Governor Yang Fu prisoner.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, Duan Shao attacked Zhou's Fen Province, captured it, and took Governor Yang Fu prisoner.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Grand Guardian Prince Yan of Langye used a forged edict to kill Recorder of the Masters of Writing He Shikai at the Southern Terrace.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Grand Guardian Prince Yan of Langye used a forged edict to kill He Shikai, recorder of the Masters of Writing, at the Southern Terrace.

literal: That same day Leading Army General Kudivolian, Secretary Attendant Censor Wang Zixuan, and others were executed; Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Feng Zicong was granted death in the palace hall.
idiomatic: That same day Leading Army General Kudivolian, secretary-attendant censor Wang Zixuan, and others were put to death; Feng Zicong, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was ordered to take his own life in the palace hall.

literal: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Capital Region Prefecture was abolished and merged into the Leading Army Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, the Capital Region Prefecture was abolished and absorbed into the Leading Army Prefecture.

literal: On the jihai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the jihai day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict dispatched Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue as envoy to Zhou.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict dispatched Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue as envoy to Zhou.

literal: On the bingyin day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, Provisional Secretariat of Xu Province, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, head of the Xu Province provisional secretariat, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the gengwu day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister over the masses.

literal: On the guiyou day, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made Left Chancellor.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made left chancellor.

literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the jisi day, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the jisi day of the first month of spring in the third year, the emperor sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven in the southern suburb.

literal: On the xinhai day, the late Prince Yan of Langye was posthumously enfeoffed as Emperor of Chu.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the late Prince Yan of Langye was posthumously ennobled as emperor of Chu.

literal: In the second month, on the jimao day, Wei Pusa was made Grand Commandant.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the jimao day, Wei Pusa was appointed grand commandant.

literal: On the xinsi day, Yuan Hai, Minister of Personnel of the Bing Secretariat, was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Yuan Hai, minister of personnel of the Bing Masters of Writing, was made right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the gengyin day, Left Deputy Director Tang Yong was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat, and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was made Left Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Left Deputy Director Tang Yong was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing, and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was appointed left deputy director.

literal: That month, an order was issued to compile the Imperial Reader of the Xuanzhou Garden; it was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity.
idiomatic: That month an order went out to compile the Imperial Reader of the Xuanzhou Garden, later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity.

literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, an edict ordered civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above each to recommend one person.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, an edict required every civil and military official of the fifth rank or higher to recommend one candidate.

literal: That month, Zhou executed the regent Yuwen Hu.
idiomatic: That month Zhou put the regent Yuwen Hu to death.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuchen day, Left Chancellor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang and his younger brother Fengle, Duke of Jingshan and Provisional Secretariat of You Province, were executed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuchen day, Left Chancellor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang and his younger brother Fengle, duke of Jingshan and head of the You Province provisional secretariat, were put to death.

literal: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, Empress Hulu was deposed and reduced to commoner status.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, Empress Hulu was deposed and reduced to a commoner.

literal: Grand Preceptor Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Right Chancellor; Grand Preceptor Prince Run of Fenyang was made Grand Commandant; Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Marshal; Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Grand General; and Prince Yanzong of Ande was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Prince Jie of Rencheng was made right chancellor; Grand Preceptor Prince Run of Fenyang was appointed grand commandant; Prince Changgong of Lanling was made grand marshal; Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made grand general; and Prince Yanzong of Ande was appointed minister over the masses.

literal: Leading Army Commandant Feng Fuxiang was dispatched as envoy to Zhou.
idiomatic: Leading Army Commandant Feng Fuxiang was sent as envoy to Zhou.

literal: On the wuzi day, Right Imperial Concubine Lady Hu was invested as empress.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Right Imperial Concubine Lady Hu was invested as empress.

literal: On the jichou day, Renjian, Prince of Beiping and Governor of Si Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Special Advancement Xu Jiliang was made Left Deputy Director; and Prince Baode of Pengcheng was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Renjian of Beiping, governor of Si Province, was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing; Xu Jiliang, special advancement, was appointed left deputy director; and Prince Baode of Pengcheng was made right deputy director.

literal: On the guisi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the guisi day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: That month, the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity was completed, and an order was issued to deliver it to the historiography archives.
idiomatic: That month the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity was completed and ordered deposited in the historiography archives.

literal: It was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Cultivating Culture.
idiomatic: It was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Cultivating Culture.

literal: In the ninth month, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, envoys from Chen arrived on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, sentences were reduced for all prisoners convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

literal: On the jiawu day, Lady Mu, Lady of Expanded Virtue, was invested as left empress, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Lady Mu, lady of expanded virtue, was invested as left empress, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Empress Hu was deposed and reduced to commoner status.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Empress Hu was deposed and reduced to a commoner.

literal: That year, Silla, Baekje, Wuji, and the Turks all sent envoys to pay court tribute.
idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Silla, Baekje, Wuji, and the Turks.

literal: This corresponded to the first year of Jiande in Zhou.
idiomatic: In Zhou this was the first year of the Jiande era.

literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the wuyin day, Gao Anagutai, Chief Minister of the Bing Secretariat, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the first month of spring in the fourth year, Gao Anagutai, chief minister of the Bing Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the gengchen day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Cui Xiang as envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Cui Xiang as envoy to Chen.

literal: That month, demonic foxes appeared in both Ye and Bing Province, and many people had their hair cut off.
idiomatic: That month demonic foxes were reported in Ye and Bing Province, and many people had locks of their hair mysteriously shorn off.

literal: In the second month, on the yisi day, Left Empress Lady Mu was invested as empress.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, Left Empress Lady Mu was invested as empress.

literal: On the bingwu day, the Wenlin Hall was established.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Wenlin Hall was established.

literal: On the yimao day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Renjian of Beiping was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, Prince Renjian of Beiping, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the dingsi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: That month, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: That month envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the third month, on the xinwei day, bandits entered Xin Province, killed Governor He Shixiu, and were suppressed by Xianyu Shirong, Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, bandits entered Xin Province, killed Governor He Shixiu, and were put down by Xianyu Shirong, governor of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the gengchen day, the imperial carriage arrived at Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the emperor arrived at Jinyang.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Guardian; Grand General Prince Chuo of Nanyang, Governor of Ding Province, was made Grand Marshal; Grand Commandant Wei Pusa was made Grand General; Minister over the Masses Prince Yanzong of Ande was made Grand Commandant; Minister of Works Prince Pu of Wuxing was made Minister over the Masses; and Zhao Yanshen, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors and Prince of Yiyang, was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Changgong of Lanling was appointed grand guardian; Grand General Prince Chuo of Nanyang, governor of Ding Province, was made grand marshal; Grand Commandant Wei Pusa was made grand general; Minister over the Masses Prince Yanzong of Ande was appointed grand commandant; Minister of Works Prince Pu of Wuxing was made minister over the masses; and Zhao Yanshen, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors and prince of Yiyang, was appointed minister of works.

literal: On the guichou day, within the enclosure of the imperial altar suddenly appeared the ruts of chariot wheels; on investigation there were no human tracks nearby, and no one knew whence the chariot had come.
idiomatic: On the guichou day, chariot wheel ruts suddenly appeared within the enclosure of the imperial altar; investigators found no human tracks nearby and could not tell whence the chariot had come.

literal: On the yimao day, an edict proclaimed this a great auspice and announced it throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, an edict declared the omen a great auspice and proclaimed it throughout the realm.

literal: On the jiwei day, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day, envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict ordered the historiographers to compile a new Book of Wei.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict ordered the historiographers to compile a new Book of Wei.

literal: On the guisi day, Leading Army Commandant Mutipo was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat, and Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Duan Xiaoyan was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the guisi day, Leading Army Commandant Mutipo was made left deputy director of the Masters of Writing, and Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Duan Xiaoyan was appointed right deputy director.

literal: That month, Yu Pohu, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, Zhangsun Honglue, and others fought the Chen general Wu Mingche south of Luliang and were greatly defeated; Pohu fled and escaped, Honglue died in battle, and thereafter Qin and Jing Provinces fell.
idiomatic: That month Yu Pohu, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, Zhangsun Honglue, and others fought Chen general Wu Mingche south of Luliang and were routed; Pohu fled to safety, Honglue was killed in battle, and Qin and Jing Provinces soon fell.

literal: Mingche advanced and captured He and Hefei Provinces.
idiomatic: Wu Mingche pressed forward and captured He and Hefei Provinces.

literal: That month, Grand Guardian Prince Changgong of Lanling was killed.
idiomatic: That month Grand Guardian Prince Changgong of Lanling was put to death.

literal: In the sixth month, Mingche advanced his army and besieged Shouyang.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Wu Mingche advanced and besieged Shouyang.

literal: On the renzi day, the emperor visited the Southern Park; sixty attending officials died of heatstroke.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, the emperor visited the Southern Park, and sixty attending officials died of heatstroke.

literal: Recorder of the Masters of Writing Gao Anagutai was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: Gao Anagutai, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister over the masses.

literal: On the bingchen day, an edict dispatched Bearer of the Grand Dignity Wang Shiluo as envoy to Zhou.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict dispatched Bearer of the Grand Dignity Wang Shiluo as envoy to Zhou.

literal: In the ninth month, a hunting expedition was conducted east of Ye.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court conducted a hunting expedition east of Ye.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Chen general Wu Mingche captured Shouyang.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Chen general Wu Mingche captured Shouyang.

literal: On the xinchou day, Palace Attendants Cui Jishu and Zhang Diaohu, Regular Attendants Liu Ti and Feng Xiaoyan, and Yellow Gate Gentlemen Pei Ze and Guo Zun were killed.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Palace Attendants Cui Jishu and Zhang Diaohu, Regular Attendants Liu Ti and Feng Xiaoyan, and Yellow Gate Gentlemen Pei Ze and Guo Zun were put to death.

literal: On the guimao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the wuyin day, Minister over the Masses Gao Anagutai was made Right Chancellor.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuyin day, Minister over the Masses Gao Anagutai was made right chancellor.

literal: That year, Goguryeo and Mojie each sent envoys to pay court tribute, and a Turk envoy came to propose marriage.
idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Goguryeo and Mojie, and a Turk envoy came seeking a marriage alliance.

literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the yichou day, one left and one right Eying were established.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the first month of spring in the fifth year, one left and one right Eying were established.

literal: In the second month, on the yiwei day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiwei day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: Prince Siho of Nan'an, Provisional Secretariat of Shuozhou, rebelled.
idiomatic: Prince Siho of Nan'an, head of the Shuozhou provisional secretariat, rebelled.

literal: On the xinchou day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: Chief Minister of the Secretariat Tang Yong and others greatly defeated Siho; Siho threw himself into the water and died, his corpse was burned, and so was his wife Lady Li.
idiomatic: Chief Minister Tang Yong and others routed Siho; Siho drowned himself, his corpse was burned, and his wife Lady Li was burned with it.

literal: On the dingwei day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Tang Yong was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister Tang Yong was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, a great drought struck; in Jinyang a drought demon was captured, two feet long, with two eyes each on its face and crown.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer a severe drought struck; in Jinyang a drought demon was captured two feet long, with two eyes on its face and two on the crown of its head.

literal: When the emperor heard of it, he immediately had a wooden figure carved in its likeness and presented it.
idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he had a wooden figure carved in its likeness and presented it at court.

literal: On the gengwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the dinghai day, Chen forces raided north of the Huai.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Chen forces raided the territory north of the Huai River.

literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guimao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: On the jiachen day, Gao Mai was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Gao Mai was appointed right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.
